name: code-janitor
description: Code Janitor cleans up and simplifies C# code: whitespace, blank lines, usings, namespaces, access modifiers, regions and modern C# syntax, with optional AI-assisted XML documentation.

commands.title: Set Custom AI Endpoint API Key
Fix All Occurrences of an .editorconfig Rule in File
Remove Region (Under Cursor or in Selection)

commandPalette.when: resourceExtname == .razor || resourceExtname == .cshtml || editorLangId == razor || editorLangId == aspnetcorerazor

codeJanitor.cleanup.onSave.description: Automatically run Code Janitor cleanup on C# files when they are saved.

codeJanitor.cleanup.onlyChangedLines.markdownDescription: Cleanup on save and **Cleanup Changed Files (Git)** only change the lines changed since the last commit (`HEAD`; every line of a new file). A rule whose change also covers unchanged lines is skipped and reported; names are not changed and types are not moved to their own files. Needs Git.

codeJanitor.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the `.editorconfig` rule violations of open C# files in the Problems panel: what cleanup would change (with quick fixes) and what it cannot fix, with the rule's `.editorconfig` severity.

codeJanitor.diagnostics.maxFileSizeKB.description: C# files larger than this (in KB) are not analyzed for diagnostics.

codeJanitor.cleanup.exclude.markdownDescription: Regular expressions matched case-insensitively against the full file path. A file matching any of them is never cleaned, for example `\.designer\.cs$` or `[\\/]obj[\\/]`.

codeJanitor.cleanup.include.markdownDescription: Regular expressions matched case-insensitively against the full file path. When this list is not empty, only files matching at least one expression are cleaned. `#codeJanitor.cleanup.exclude#` still wins.

codeJanitor.cleanup.showOptionsDialog.markdownDescription: Before **Cleanup Selected Files** starts, ask whether to start the cleanup or to preview the C# text changes first (the Visual Studio options dialog). Off: the command starts the cleanup at once.

codeJanitor.preview.maxFileSizeKB.markdownDescription: The cleanup preview skips C# files larger than this many KiB (it lists them as skipped).

codeJanitor.switching.relatedFileExtensi.markdownDescription: Groups of related file endings for **Switch to Related File**: endings separated by spaces, groups by `||`. The command opens the first existing file with another ending of the group (endings listed after the current one are tried first).

codeJanitor.cleanup.includeOtherFileType.description: Also clean up files that are not C#. Only the layout rules run for them (BOM, tabs, trailing whitespace, blank lines, final newline).

codeJanitor.cleanup.moveUsingsOutsideNam.markdownDescription: Move using directives outside the namespace declaration, so they sit at the top of the file instead of nested inside `namespace { ... }`. A name such as `using Services;` inside `namespace Company.App` can mean `Company.App.Services`, so a moved directive is written fully qualified, and only when the declarations of the project (and the projects it references) prove that every name in the file binds as before; otherwise the directives stay where they are and the reason is written to the Code Janitor output. `csharp_using_directive_placement` in `.editorconfig` overrides this setting (`inside_namespace` moves the directives into the namespace instead).

codeJanitor.cleanup.organizeUsings.description: Sort using directives (System first, then alphabetical), independent of .editorconfig.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertToFileScopedN.markdownDescription: Convert a single top-level block-scoped namespace to a file-scoped namespace: `namespace Demo { ... }` becomes `namespace Demo;`, removing one level of indentation. Only for a project known to use C# 10 or newer (otherwise the namespace stays block-scoped and the reason is reported); skipped when the file declares more than one or a nested namespace, has types outside the namespace, or a `#if`/`#region` block that straddles the braces. Using directives inside the namespace stay there.

codeJanitor.cleanup.insertExplicitAccess.description: Insert the default access modifier on declarations that omit it (classes, methods, fields, properties, etc.).

codeJanitor.cleanup.insertBlankLinePaddi.description: Insert blank line padding before/after declarations, regions and using blocks.

codeJanitor.cleanup.insertBlankLineBefor.description: Insert a blank line before 'return' and 'throw' statements.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeRegions.markdownDescription: Remove `#region` and `#endregion` directives. The region names are discarded, so turn this off if you organize code with regions.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeByteOrderMark.description: Remove a leading Unicode Byte Order Mark (BOM) from source files.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeEndOfLineWhite.description: Remove trailing whitespace at the end of each line.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeBlankLinesAtTo.description: Remove blank lines at the top of the file.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeBlankLinesAtBo.description: Remove blank lines at the bottom of the file.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeBlankLinesAfte.description: Remove blank lines directly after attribute declarations.
Remove blank lines directly after an opening brace.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeBlankLinesBefo.description: Remove blank lines directly before a closing brace.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeBlankLinesBetw.description: Remove blank lines before chained 'else'/'catch'/'finally' clauses.

codeJanitor.cleanup.removeMultipleConsec.description: Collapse two or more consecutive blank lines into one.

codeJanitor.cleanup.updateEndRegionDirec.markdownDescription: Update `#endregion` directives to include the matching `#region` name. Only has an effect when `#codeJanitor.cleanup.removeRegions#` is off.

codeJanitor.cleanup.updateSingleLineMeth.markdownDescription: Reformat single-line methods and properties onto multiple lines, so `void M() { }` becomes a normal braced body. Keeps declaration layout consistent across the file.

codeJanitor.cleanup.updateAccessorsToBot.markdownDescription: Ensure both accessors of a property use the same layout: if one is multi-line, `get`/`set` are both expanded, otherwise both are collapsed onto one line.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertToVarWhenAppa.description: Convert local variable declarations to 'var' when the type is apparent from the right-hand side.

codeJanitor.cleanup.makeFieldsReadonlyWh.description: Add the 'readonly' modifier to fields that are provably never written outside their declaring constructor.

codeJanitor.cleanup.sealClassesWhenSafe.description: Add the 'sealed' modifier to classes that are not derived from within the same file.

codeJanitor.cleanup.renamePublicSymbolsA.description: Cleanup Selected Files and Cleanup Workspace: rename public and internal symbols that break the .editorconfig naming rules (IDE1006) in every file of their project and of the projects referencing it, after showing the list of renames. Renames that cannot be proven safe (names used as text, NuGet package APIs, virtual members, ...) are reported instead. Never runs on save.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertToCollectionE.description: Convert List<T>/array initializations to C# 12 collection expressions ([] / [a, b, c]).

codeJanitor.cleanup.reuseJsonSerializerO.description: Replace direct 'new JsonSerializerOptions()' arguments in JsonSerializer calls with default(JsonSerializerOptions), or with null for a named 'options:' argument, to avoid per-call allocation (CA1869).

codeJanitor.cleanup.simplifySingleStatem.markdownDescription: Simplify single-statement lambda block bodies to expression bodies: `x => { return x + 1; }` becomes `x => x + 1`.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertToPatternMatc.markdownDescription: Convert null checks to pattern matching: `x == null` becomes `x is null` and `x != null` becomes `x is not null`.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertStringFormatT.markdownDescription: Convert `string.Format` calls to string interpolation: `string.Format("Hi {0}", name)` becomes `$"Hi {name}"`.

codeJanitor.cleanup.convertToStringNameO.markdownDescription: Convert string literals that name a parameter or member to the `nameof` operator, so `throw new ArgumentNullException("name")` becomes `nameof(name)` and survives renames.

codeJanitor.cleanup.inlineOutVariableDec.markdownDescription: Inline `out` variable declarations into the call itself: a separate `int value;` before `TryParse(text, out value)` becomes `TryParse(text, out int value)`.

codeJanitor.cleanup.codeStyleRules.markdownDescription: Roslyn code-style options Code Janitor applies when the repository's `.editorconfig` does not enforce them: each entry enables one rule with its value, as `suggestion`; rules that are not listed are off. A rule `.editorconfig` enforces keeps its `.editorconfig` value, and the `cleanup.codeStyle` section of `.codejanitor` (a value enables the rule, `null` disables it) wins over this setting. Nothing is written to `.editorconfig`. Naming rules (`dotnet_naming_*`) are configured in `.editorconfig` only.

codeJanitor.cleanup.fileHeaderCSharp.description: Configured C# file header text. Leave empty to disable file header cleanup.

enumDescriptions: Place the header on the very first line, above any using directives.
Place the header below the using directives, directly before the namespace or type.
codeJanitor.cleanup.fileHeaderPosition.description: Where the configured file header should be placed.

enumDescriptions: Add the header only when the file does not already start with it, leaving existing comments alone.
Replace the existing leading comment block with the configured header.
codeJanitor.cleanup.fileHeaderUpdateMode.description: Whether the configured file header is inserted alongside existing content or replaces it.

codeJanitor.cleanup.formatComments.markdownDescription: Normalize comment spacing and alignment, so `//comment` becomes `// comment` and comment blocks line up consistently.

codeJanitor.cleanup.formatRazorComponent.markdownDescription: Also format Razor components and views (`.razor`, `.cshtml`) during cleanup: the C# of `@code` / `@functions` blocks and of `@if`, `@else`, `@for`, `@foreach`, `@while`, `@switch`, `@try`, `@catch` and `@finally` blocks. Markup is never reformatted, and code the formatter cannot read with certainty is left as authored. The `Format Razor` command works whatever this says. Respects `#codeJanitor.cleanup.include#` and `#codeJanitor.cleanup.exclude#`.

codeJanitor.razor.indentSize.markdownDescription: Columns of one indent level the Razor formatter uses for blocks and their C#.

enumDescriptions: Follow the file: tabs when most of its indented lines use them, spaces otherwise.
codeJanitor.razor.indentStyle.markdownDescription: How the Razor formatter indents blocks and their C#.

codeJanitor.reorganize.alphabetizeMember.description: Alphabetize members of the same group.

codeJanitor.reorganize.explicitMembersAt.description: Place explicit interface members at the end of their group.

codeJanitor.reorganize.keepMembersWithin.markdownDescription: Keep members within their regions: each region is sorted on its own. Turn off to sort the members across regions (the `#region` and `#endregion` lines stay where they are).

enumDescriptions: Ask before reorganizing a file with `#if` or `#pragma` (cleanup skips such a file, as it cannot ask).
Reorganize it: each `#if` block moves as a whole with its member, and members never move across a `#pragma`.
Never reorganize a file with preprocessor conditionals.
codeJanitor.reorganize.performWhenPrepro.description: Perform reorganization when preprocessor conditionals are present.

codeJanitor.reorganize.primaryOrderByAcc.description: Order by access level first and by member type second (off: by member type, then access level).

codeJanitor.reorganize.reverseOrderByAcc.description: Order access levels from private to public (off: public to private).

enumDescriptions: Use the GitHub Copilot Chat model selected via VS Code's Language Model API (requires the GitHub Copilot Chat extension, signed in).
Use a custom OpenAI/Claude-compatible HTTP endpoint (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic-compatible proxy).
codeJanitor.ai.provider.description: AI provider used for AI-assisted features (e.g. XML documentation generation).

codeJanitor.ai.copilotModel.markdownDescription: Copilot model to use, matched against the models your own GitHub Copilot subscription currently exposes (no fixed list is built in). Leave empty to use whichever model Copilot offers first. Run **Code Janitor: Use GitHub Copilot Model...** to pick one from your actual, live model list instead of typing a name here.

codeJanitor.ai.customEndpointUrl.markdownDescription: Custom OpenAI/Claude-compatible chat completions endpoint URL, used when `#codeJanitor.ai.provider#` is `custom`.

codeJanitor.ai.customModel.description: Model name sent to the custom endpoint.

codeJanitor.ai.customApiKeyHeader.markdownDescription: HTTP header name used to send the custom endpoint API key. The key itself is stored in secret storage by the command **Code Janitor: Set Custom AI Endpoint API Key**, never in settings.

codeJanitor.ai.customTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for a single custom AI endpoint request.

codeJanitor.ai.customContextWindowTokens.markdownDescription: Context window hint (sent as `num_ctx`) for local custom endpoints only, such as llama.cpp or LM Studio. Hosted APIs ignore it. Set to 0 to stop sending the hint.

codeJanitor.ai.maxTokensPerRequest.description: Maximum number of tokens a single custom endpoint response may contain, for the explain, review, refactor and unit test actions. GitHub Copilot manages this itself and ignores the setting.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.maxMembersPerFile.description: Maximum number of members per file that may trigger an AI request when generating XML documentation. Properties, fields, indexers and events are documented deterministically and never count against this limit.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.maxInputCharsPerMe.description: Maximum number of characters of a member's body sent to the AI provider as prompt context.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.maxTokensPerReques.description: Maximum number of tokens a single documentation response may contain. A summary is one sentence, so the default is deliberately small. Applies to custom endpoints only.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.allowDeterministic.description: Fall back to a deterministic, name-derived summary when the AI request fails or returns nothing.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.previewChanges.description: Show a diff of the generated documentation and ask for confirmation before applying it.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.ignoreTestMethods.description: Skip test methods (test attributes) and types whose name ends with 'Test'/'Tests'.

codeJanitor.ai.xmlDoc.ignorePattern.description: Regular expression matched against 'Namespace.Type.Method'. Matching methods are skipped.

codeJanitor.ai.tests.framework.description: Test framework the AI should target when generating unit tests (e.g. xUnit, NUnit, MSTest).

codeJanitor.ai.tests.mockingLibrary.description: Mocking library the AI should use when generating unit tests (e.g. Moq, NSubstitute, FakeItEasy).

scripts.package: npm run build && npx vsce package
